correctness.rationale: For the precise infinite-lattice process, the graphical ancestor bound establishes finite-time well-posedness. A cavity survival renewal calculation uniquely solves g(t)=exp[-t/2-(1-exp(-t))/2]. The independently labelled left/right first-occupation times give the exact no-deposition factor exp[-(T_-+T_+)/2]; integrating their weighted distributions yields B(t)=0.5(1-exp(-t))^2 exp[-(1-exp(-t))]. Eventual cavity occupancy and nonblocking successful hazard give rigorous jam density. A separate executable checked 23 exact/functional assertions and 6 stochastic time comparisons; simulations are not used as proof.
